rubrics.justification: Description is detailed and broadly consistent with an expanded high-quality blastocyst, including ICM, TE, blastocoel, and thinning zona; however, it likely overstates certainty from a single image and calls 3AA the highest category despite higher expansion stages existing.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, response to stimulation, endometrium, male factor, BMI, cycle history, and lifestyle with embryo quality and prognosis.

Overall logic is clear and internally consistent, with a reasonable prognosis framework; minor issues include somewhat confident quantitative adjustments and a few speculative factors such as former smoking and exercise effects.

Generally aligned with IVF practice: SET recommendation, recognition of age-related aneuploidy, and morphology-based assessment are appropriate. Small deviations include overemphasis on PGT-A after one failure and mention of ERA relatively early, which is not routine guideline-based care.

Provides practical recommendations for transfer management, SET, luteal support, follow-up, cryopreservation, and contingency planning; some suggestions are more generic or speculative than strictly necessary.
